/**
 * FROZEN acceptance spec — loop `.cursor/loops/stall-probes`.
 *
 * verify.sh copies this file to `src/loop/__acceptance__/stallProbes.acceptance.test.ts`,
 * typechecks it with the repo, runs it with vitest, then deletes the copy.
 * Its sha256 is pinned in verify.sh. Do not edit it; make the code satisfy it.
 */
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'
import fs from 'node:fs'
import os from 'node:os'
import path from 'node:path'
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import { repoProfileSchema } from '../../context/repoProfile.js'
import { runAgentLoop } from '../agentLoop.js'
import { loopConfigSchema } from '../loopConfig.js'
import { resolveStagnationPolicy } from '../loopStagnationPolicy.js'
import {
  STALL_PROBE_VARIANTS,
  buildStallProbePromptSection,
  createGitWorkspacePort,
  pickStallProbeWinner,
  type WorkspacePort,
} from '../loopStallProbes.js'
import { runVerifyCommand, type VerifyResult } from '../loopVerify.js'

vi.mock('../loopVerify.js', () => ({ runVerifyCommand: vi.fn() }))
vi.mock('../loopGit.js', async (importOriginal) => {
  const actual = await importOriginal<typeof import('../loopGit.js')>()
  return {
    ...actual,
    captureGitWorkspaceSnapshot: vi.fn(() => ({
      branch: 'main',
      shortSha: 'abc1234',
      diffStat: ' src/stuck.ts | 4 ++--',
      statusPorcelain: ' M src/stuck.ts',
    })),
  }
})

const mockedVerify = vi.mocked(runVerifyCommand)
const VERIFY_CMD = 'bash .cursor/loops/acc-stall/verify.sh'
const PROCEDURE = '## Stall probe: procedure hints'
const FACTS = '## Stall probe: repo facts'

let loopDir: string
let repoRoot: string

function pass(): VerifyResult {
  return { complete: true, command: VERIFY_CMD, exitCode: 0, stdout: 'ok', stderr: '', reason: 'Verifier passed (exit 0).' }
}
function fail(stdout = 'FAIL src/stuck.test.ts > same failure'): VerifyResult {
  return { complete: false, command: VERIFY_CMD, exitCode: 1, stdout, stderr: '', reason: 'Verifier failed (exit 1).' }
}

function bundle(overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {
  return {
    loopDir,
    goal: 'Acceptance goal for stall-probes.',
    config: loopConfigSchema.parse({
      verify: VERIFY_CMD,
      maxIterations: 4,
      delayMs: 0,
      postQualityReview: false,
      reviewGate: false,
      syncOnSuccess: false,
      stagnationThreshold: 5,
      escalateAfterStagnation: 2,
      exportPack: false,
      exportRunReport: false,
      exportTranscript: false,
      stallProbes: true,
      ...overrides,
    }),
    logPath: path.join(loopDir, 'log.ndjson'),
  }
}

function ctx() {
  return { repoRoot, profile: repoProfileSchema.parse({ syncCommand: null }) }
}

type Op = { kind: 'worker'; prompt: string } | { kind: 'snapshot'; id: number } | { kind: 'restore'; id: number }

function harness() {
  const ops: Op[] = []
  let next = 0
  const port: WorkspacePort<{ id: number }> = {
    snapshot: () => {
      next += 1
      ops.push({ kind: 'snapshot', id: next })
      return { id: next }
    },
    restore: (snap) => {
      ops.push({ kind: 'restore', id: snap.id })
    },
  }
  const runIterationPrompt = vi.fn(async (prompt: string) => {
    ops.push({ kind: 'worker', prompt })
    return { text: 'edited' }
  })
  const workers = () => ops.filter((o): o is Extract<Op, { kind: 'worker' }> => o.kind === 'worker')
  return { ops, port, workers, workerSession: { runIterationPrompt, dispose: vi.fn(async () => undefined) } }
}

function opsBetween(ops: Op[], fromWorker: number, toWorker: number): Op[] {
  const idx: number[] = []
  ops.forEach((o, i) => { if (o.kind === 'worker') idx.push(i) })
  return ops.slice(idx[fromWorker]! + 1, toWorker < idx.length ? idx[toWorker] : ops.length)
}

beforeEach(() => {
  vi.clearAllMocks()
  loopDir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'acc-stall-loop-'))
  repoRoot = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'acc-stall-repo-'))
})

describe('stall-probes: policy', () => {
  it('stallProbes defaults to false and the old policy is unchanged', () => {
    const config = loopConfigSchema.parse({ verify: 'true', escalateAfterStagnation: 2 })
    expect(config.stallProbes).toBe(false)
    const policy = resolveStagnationPolicy(config, 2)
    expect(policy.escalationRepeatCount).toBe(2)
    expect(policy.probeRepeatCount).toBeUndefined()
  })

  it('probes first, escalates the model only after probes were used', () => {
    const config = loopConfigSchema.parse({ verify: 'true', escalateAfterStagnation: 2, stallProbes: true })
    expect(resolveStagnationPolicy(config, 1).probeRepeatCount).toBeUndefined()
    const first = resolveStagnationPolicy(config, 2)
    expect(first.probeRepeatCount).toBe(2)
    expect(first.escalationRepeatCount).toBeUndefined()
    const after = resolveStagnationPolicy(config, 3, true)
    expect(after.probeRepeatCount).toBeUndefined()
    expect(after.escalationRepeatCount).toBe(3)
  })

  it('stagnationThreshold 0 disables probes too', () => {
    const config = loopConfigSchema.parse({ verify: 'true', stagnationThreshold: 0, stallProbes: true })
    expect(resolveStagnationPolicy(config, 4).probeRepeatCount).toBeUndefined()
  })
})

describe('stall-probes: prompt sections and winner', () => {
  it('has exactly two variants with distinct guidance', () => {
    expect([...STALL_PROBE_VARIANTS]).toEqual(['procedure', 'facts'])
    const input = { verifyCommand: VERIFY_CMD, lastVerify: fail('\nFAIL src/stuck.test.ts > first line\nmore'), diffStat: ' src/stuck.ts | 4 ++--' }
    const procedure = buildStallProbePromptSection('procedure', input)
    const facts = buildStallProbePromptSection('facts', input)
    expect(procedure).toContain(PROCEDURE)
    expect(facts).toContain(FACTS)
    expect(procedure).not.toContain(FACTS)
    expect(facts).not.toContain(PROCEDURE)
    expect(procedure).toContain(VERIFY_CMD)
    expect(facts).toContain(VERIFY_CMD)
    expect(facts).toContain('src/stuck.ts')
    expect(facts).toContain('FAIL src/stuck.test.ts > first line')
  })

  it('green beats moved beats stalled; ties go to the earlier variant; nothing moved → undefined', () => {
    const stalled = fail()
    const moved = fail('FAIL src/stuck.test.ts > a different failure')
    expect(pickStallProbeWinner(stalled, [{ variant: 'procedure', verify: stalled }, { variant: 'facts', verify: pass() }])).toBe('facts')
    expect(pickStallProbeWinner(stalled, [{ variant: 'procedure', verify: moved }, { variant: 'facts', verify: pass() }])).toBe('facts')
    expect(pickStallProbeWinner(stalled, [{ variant: 'procedure', verify: moved }, { variant: 'facts', verify: stalled }])).toBe('procedure')
    expect(pickStallProbeWinner(stalled, [{ variant: 'procedure', verify: moved }, { variant: 'facts', verify: moved }])).toBe('procedure')
    expect(pickStallProbeWinner(stalled, [{ variant: 'procedure', verify: stalled }, { variant: 'facts', verify: stalled }])).toBeUndefined()
  })
})

describe('stall-probes: git workspace port', () => {
  function sh(cwd: string, ...args: string[]): string {
    return execFileSync('git', args, { cwd, encoding: 'utf8' })
  }

  it('restores tracked edits and untracked files, leaves ignored files and HEAD alone, leaves no stash', async () => {
    const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'acc-stall-git-'))
    sh(dir, 'init', '-q')
    sh(dir, 'config', 'user.email', 'acc@example.com')
    sh(dir, 'config', 'user.name', 'acc')
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, '.gitignore'), 'ignored.log\n')
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'a.txt'), 'v1\n')
    sh(dir, 'add', '.')
    sh(dir, 'commit', '-qm', 'init')
    const head = sh(dir, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD').trim()

    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'a.txt'), 'v2\n')
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'b.txt'), 'new\n')
    const port = createGitWorkspacePort(dir)
    const snap = await port.snapshot()

    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'a.txt'), 'v3\n')
    fs.rmSync(path.join(dir, 'b.txt'))
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'c.txt'), 'probe junk\n')
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'ignored.log'), 'keep me\n')
    await port.restore(snap)

    expect(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, 'a.txt'), 'utf8')).toBe('v2\n')
    expect(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, 'b.txt'), 'utf8')).toBe('new\n')
    expect(fs.existsSync(path.join(dir, 'c.txt'))).toBe(false)
    expect(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, 'ignored.log'), 'utf8')).toBe('keep me\n')
    expect(sh(dir, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD').trim()).toBe(head)
    expect(sh(dir, 'stash', 'list').trim()).toBe('')
  })
})

describe('stall-probes: wired into runAgentLoop', () => {
  it('runs procedure then facts on a stall, restores between them, and keeps a green facts probe', async () => {
    mockedVerify
      .mockReturnValueOnce(fail())
      .mockReturnValueOnce(fail())
      .mockReturnValueOnce(fail())
      .mockReturnValueOnce(pass())
    const h = harness()
    const result = await runAgentLoop({ ctx: ctx(), bundle: bundle(), workerSession: h.workerSession, workspacePort: h.port })
    expect(result.complete).toBe(true)
    const workers = h.workers()
    expect(workers).toHaveLength(4)
    expect(workers[0]!.prompt).not.toContain('## Stall probe')
    expect(workers[1]!.prompt).not.toContain('## Stall probe')
    expect(workers[2]!.prompt).toContain(PROCEDURE)
    expect(workers[3]!.prompt).toContain(FACTS)
    const beforeA = opsBetween(h.ops, 1, 2)
    expect(beforeA.some((o) => o.kind === 'snapshot')).toBe(true)
    const s0 = beforeA.filter((o) => o.kind === 'snapshot')[0] as { id: number }
    const betweenAandB = opsBetween(h.ops, 2, 3)
    const restores = betweenAandB.filter((o) => o.kind === 'restore') as Array<{ id: number }>
    expect(restores.map((r) => r.id)).toContain(s0.id)
    const afterB = opsBetween(h.ops, 3, 4)
    expect(afterB.filter((o) => o.kind === 'restore')).toHaveLength(0)
  })

  it('stops after a green procedure probe without running the facts probe', async () => {
    mockedVerify.mockReturnValueOnce(fail()).mockReturnValueOnce(fail()).mockReturnValueOnce(pass())
    const h = harness()
    const result = await runAgentLoop({ ctx: ctx(), bundle: bundle(), workerSession: h.workerSession, workspacePort: h.port })
    expect(result.complete).toBe(true)
    expect(h.workers()).toHaveLength(3)
    expect(h.workers()[2]!.prompt).toContain(PROCEDURE)
  })

  it('keeps the procedure workspace when only procedure moved the failure', async () => {
    mockedVerify
      .mockReturnValueOnce(fail())
      .mockReturnValueOnce(fail())
      .mockReturnValueOnce(fail('FAIL src/stuck.test.ts > moved on'))
      .mockReturnValueOnce(fail())
      .mockReturnValue(fail('FAIL src/stuck.test.ts > moved on'))
    const h = harness()
    await runAgentLoop({ ctx: ctx(), bundle: bundle(), workerSession: h.workerSession, workspacePort: h.port })
    const workers = h.workers()
    expect(workers).toHaveLength(5)
    const s0 = opsBetween(h.ops, 1, 2).filter((o) => o.kind === 'snapshot')[0] as { id: number }
    const afterB = opsBetween(h.ops, 3, 4)
    const lastRestore = afterB.filter((o) => o.kind === 'restore').pop() as { id: number } | undefined
    expect(lastRestore).toBeDefined()
    expect(lastRestore!.id).not.toBe(s0.id)
    expect(workers[4]!.prompt).not.toContain('## Stall probe')
    expect(workers[4]!.prompt).toContain('moved on')
  })

  it('restores the pre-probe workspace when neither probe moved, then never probes again in the run', async () => {
    mockedVerify.mockReturnValue(fail())
    const h = harness()
    const result = await runAgentLoop({ ctx: ctx(), bundle: bundle(), workerSession: h.workerSession, workspacePort: h.port })
    expect(result.complete).toBe(false)
    const workers = h.workers()
    expect(workers).toHaveLength(5)
    const s0 = opsBetween(h.ops, 1, 2).filter((o) => o.kind === 'snapshot')[0] as { id: number }
    const lastRestore = opsBetween(h.ops, 3, 4).filter((o) => o.kind === 'restore').pop() as { id: number } | undefined
    expect(lastRestore?.id).toBe(s0.id)
    expect(workers[4]!.prompt).not.toContain('## Stall probe')
  })

  it('logs one iteration line per probe with its variant and whether it was kept', async () => {
    mockedVerify
      .mockReturnValueOnce(fail())
      .mockReturnValueOnce(fail())
      .mockReturnValueOnce(fail())
      .mockReturnValueOnce(pass())
    const h = harness()
    await runAgentLoop({ ctx: ctx(), bundle: bundle(), workerSession: h.workerSession, workspacePort: h.port })
    const lines = fs
      .readFileSync(path.join(loopDir, 'log.ndjson'), 'utf8')
      .split('\n')
      .filter(Boolean)
      .map((l) => JSON.parse(l) as { probe?: { variant: string; kept: boolean } })
    const probes = lines.filter((l) => l.probe).map((l) => l.probe!)
    expect(probes).toEqual([
      { variant: 'procedure', kept: false },
      { variant: 'facts', kept: true },
    ])
  })

  it('does nothing new when stallProbes is off', async () => {
    mockedVerify.mockReturnValue(fail())
    const h = harness()
    await runAgentLoop({ ctx: ctx(), bundle: bundle({ stallProbes: false }), workerSession: h.workerSession, workspacePort: h.port })
    expect(h.workers()).toHaveLength(4)
    for (const w of h.workers()) expect(w.prompt).not.toContain('## Stall probe')
    expect(h.ops.filter((o) => o.kind !== 'worker')).toHaveLength(0)
  })
})
